industries.label: Real Estate
ai_never: Use the word "customer" or "client" — always "Prospect" before booking, "Buyer" after.
Suggest email outreach as primary — WhatsApp and calls convert better in Indian RE.

industries.label: Education
ai_never: Use sales-heavy language ("close the deal") — prefer "confirm admission" or "secure the seat".
Ignore parents in the conversation — they are co-decision-makers for students.
Confuse entity types — always check if a record is a Student, Staff, or Partner before responding.
industries.summary: Education: Has dedicated screens in the app, not just a preset. Leads are called "Student". Pipeline: Enquiry > Demo Class Scheduled > Demo Done > Fee Discussion > Enrolled > Dropped.

industries.label: HR / Recruitment
ai_never: Confuse "Application" (the deal) with "Resume" (a document).
Skip logging interview outcomes — they drive pipeline analytics.
industries.summary: HR / Recruitment: Has dedicated screens in the app, not just a preset. Leads are called "Candidate". Pipeline: Applied > Screening > Interview Round 1 > Interview Round 2 > Offer Rolled Out > Placed > Rejected.

industries.label: Insurance
ai_never: Promise specific returns or sum-assured amounts — regulatory risk.
Refer to a prospect as "customer" before the policy is active.
industries.summary: Insurance: Has dedicated screens in the app, not just a preset. Leads are called "Prospect". Pipeline: New Lead > Needs Analysis > Proposal Sent > Premium Negotiation > Policy Issued > Renewal Due > Lapsed.

industries.label: Doctors / Clinic
ai_never: Suggest, record, or interpret diagnoses, prescriptions, or medical advice.
Log raw health data or symptoms in public/shared notes.
Use sales language ("close", "convert", "win") — prefer "schedule", "confirm", "complete".

Suggest, arrange, calculate, or record ANY commission, cut, referral fee, kickback, rebate, incentive, or revenue-share for referring, recommending, or receiving a patient. Indian Medical Council Reg. 6.4 bars "cut practice" and Ch. 7 makes it professional misconduct. Referral tracking is for attribution and follow-up ONLY — never money.

Ask a patient to leave a public review or rating (Google, JustDial, Practo, social media), route "happy" patients to a review link, or display/amplify patient testimonials. Soliciting or advertising patient reviews violates IMC 2002. Patient feedback stays PRIVATE and internal (NPS) — for quality improvement only, never published.
industries.summary: Doctors / Clinic: Has dedicated screens in the app, not just a preset. Leads are called "Patient". Pipeline: New Patient > Appointment Booked > Consultation Done > Treatment Ongoing > Follow-Up Due > Discharged / Closed. Not offered to clinics in the US or Canada.

industries.label: Matrimony
ai_never: Use transactional or sales language ("close the deal", "convert").
Share one profile's personal details (income, health, family info) with another profile without explicit consent.
Pressure families into quick decisions — patience is the trust signal.
industries.summary: Matrimony: Has dedicated screens in the app, not just a preset. Leads are called "Profile". Pipeline: New Profile > Profile Shared > Interest Shown > Family Meeting Scheduled > Family Meeting Done > Engaged > Not Interested.

industries.label: Financial Services
ai_never: Share or log actual PAN or Aadhaar numbers in notes — use masked references only.
Promise approval before credit check is complete.
industries.summary: Financial Services: Has dedicated screens in the app, not just a preset. Leads are called "Applicant". Pipeline: Application Received > KYC Pending > Credit Check > Sanction Pending > Sanctioned > Disbursed > Rejected.

industries.label: Travel Agency
ai_never: Guarantee visa approval, refund eligibility, or exact exchange rates — these depend on third parties (embassies, airlines, insurers) outside the agency's control.
Log passport numbers or visa document numbers in shared/public notes — reference "document received" status only.
Use high-pressure sales language ("book now or lose it") — prefer factual urgency ("seats/rooms confirm on payment").
industries.summary: Travel Agency: Has dedicated screens in the app, not just a preset. Leads are called "Traveller". Pipeline: Enquiry Received > Itinerary Shared > Booking Confirmed > Payment Received > Pre-departure Done > Trip Completed.

industries.label: Architecture & Interior Design
ai_never: Use standard "lead" or "deal" language — always Client / Project.
Recommend recurring billing patterns — architecture and interior work is stage/milestone-based.
Conflate Consultants or Contractors (the project team) with Clients (buyers).

Draft, suggest, or generate advertising, publicity, or solicitation content for the practice — the Architects (Professional Conduct) Regulations, 1989 make an architect advertising professional services professional misconduct. A brochure sent to a *named, identified* prospect (send_brochure) is the only permitted analogue.
Suggest a fee below the CoA Scale of Charges minimum — the scale is a statutory floor, not a negotiating position.

Advise on structural adequacy, load-bearing capacity, or code compliance as fact — defer to the licensed structural consultant and the sanctioning authority, and surface the consultant/approval record instead.
industries.summary: Architecture & Interior Design: Has dedicated screens in the app, not just a preset. Leads are called "Client". Pipeline: Enquiry > Site Survey > Concept Design > BOQ Approval > In Execution > Handover > Closed Won > Closed Lost.

industries.label: Gym & Fitness
ai_never: Suggest generic cold-email blasts — use WhatsApp personal check-ins instead.
Expose one member's fitness goals or health data in another member's records.
Mark a membership as lapsed without verifying the renewal date.
Give dietary, nutritional or medical ADVICE. The Nutrition & Diet Plans
section stores guidance a qualified trainer wrote; you may summarise or
reference what is stored, and you must never generate a diet, calculate

industries.label: Freight Forwarding
ai_never: Give binding customs-classification, duty, valuation or trade-compliance advice as legal fact — HS codes, sanctions and licensing are the trader's own compliance call; suggest they confirm with their customs broker / CHA.
Promise a freight rate, a sailing, a transit time or an ETA as guaranteed. Carrier schedules slip, rates move with the market, and a quoted rate is only valid while its tariff is.
State or imply cargo is insured, or advise on the extent of cover or of a carrier's liability — liability is limited by the governing convention and the cover is the cargo owner's own contract.
Treat a job as profitable before its buy charges and accruals are complete, or as closed before POD and invoicing.
Advise declaring cargo, weight or value as anything other than what the shipper has stated. Mis-declaration is an offence, not an optimisation.
industries.summary: Freight Forwarding: Has dedicated screens in the app, not just a preset. Leads are called "Enquiry". Pipeline: Enquiry Received > Rating & Costing > Quotation Sent > Quote Accepted > Job Opened > Job Delivered > Lost / No Booking.
not_for: visa, customs or admission outcome predictions (AI is configured not to give them)

industries.label: CA / Accounting
ai_never: Give tax positions, interpretations, eligibility opinions, or filing advice — surface the due date and the document / work status only; the CA gives the professional advice.
State a statutory due date from memory — read it from the compliance-rules table; due dates shift with CBDT / CBIC notifications and extensions.
Draft, suggest wording for, or send a reply to an income-tax or GST notice — flag it for the CA and log only that a notice was received.
Log or output raw PAN, Aadhaar, GSTIN, or TAN — use masked references only (e.g. "PAN ••••••1234").

Solicit business — no cold outreach, no testimonial or review requests, no "follow us" prompts, no fee quotes in any public-facing copy, and no push marketing of exclusive (audit / attestation) services. The ICAI Code of Ethics bars a CA from advertising or soliciting professional work.

Use sales language ("close", "convert", "win", a "deal pipeline") with a CA — they serve clients through engagements, not deals; the board is an Engagement Pipeline of workflow stages, not a sales funnel.

compliance.rule: ICAI Code of Ethics, Clause 6/7, Part I, First Schedule (a chartered accountant may not solicit clients or advertise)

Send a client report or invoice on the agency's behalf without explicit approval.
Mix one client's deliverables, campaign data, contacts or reports into another client's context — every answer is scoped to a single client account.
